text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinians denounce Zionist crimes in Jerusalem.
- National Assembly calls on Arab and foreign parliaments to work for removal of Western-imposed no-fly zones over Iraq.
- Trade Ministry ferries huge quantities of food to state-run stores.
- France criticises U.S. policy toward Iraq.
- China warns against U.S. presence in Arab Gulf.
- Egyptian foreign minister calls for implementation of oil-for-food deal.
- Chinese communists review bilateral ties with Iraqi Baathists in Beijing.
- Vice-President Ramadan meets Vietnamese finance minister.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ).
- Commentary assails Iran for hostile stands against Iraq.
